Mexico vs Jamaica Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Mexico and Jamaica meet in the CONCACAF Nations League on 18 November 2026 with kickoff scheduled for 02:30 UTC. The match is part of the 2026–27 Nations League group stage, though the specific matchday and group have not been confirmed. The venue for this fixture has not been officially announced; it may be played in Mexico, Jamaica, or at a neutral site depending on the competition format.

Mexico hold a dominant historical record against Jamaica, with 18 wins in 25 meetings, while Jamaica have won four times and three matches have ended in draws. The most recent encounter was a 1–0 Mexico victory in the 2024 Copa América. Both teams will view this fixture as important for their Nations League standing, which influences seeding for the Gold Cup and potential progression to the Nations League finals.

Jamaica’s best route to a result lies in defensive compactness and quick transitions via Bailey and Gray.
